# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large concatenation of real call recordings, but **only a minority are genuine sales/enquiry calls**. The majority are internal-ops chatter (crane/loading, driver coordination, bill-copy/WhatsApp handovers, attendance, "material ready-ஆ"/dispatch-timing calls), payment-collection follow-ups, wrong numbers, voicemails, and two telemarketing cold-calls received by Crayon staff (Sakshi Software, Innovative Digital Solutions — irrelevant). After filtering, roughly **40-50 calls** are usable for sales training: outbound tele-calling scripts to new leads, inbound dealer/customer rate enquiries, quotation negotiations, tile/profile fabrication order discussions, credit-term pushback, and a few B2B/expo conversations. The company is **Crayon Roofing and Structures**, a Chennai-based (Manali/Andarkuppam) **JSW Steel colour-coated roofing sheet distributor/trader**, also dealing in **PUF insulated panels, polycarbonate sheets, MS pipe/purlin (Z/C), screws (Tata brand), welding rods, and roofing accessories (L-flashing, ridge, rain-cutter, canopy sheet, crimp/tile profile)**. Given the thin volume of pure sales calls, this KB stays close to what is actually said rather than expanding into generic playbook theory.

## Products & brand ladder
- **JSW Steel colour-coated roofing sheets** — core product. Brand ladder repeatedly mentioned in order of positioning:
  - **Color On Plus** (JSW flagship, premium) — thickness 0.47mm / 0.50mm / 0.60mm; colours: Sky Blue, Off White, Graphite/Pencil Grey, Royal/Nova Blue, Brick Red, Mist Green, Bare (non-colour).
  - **Radiance** (JSW) — positioned below Color On Plus; stock frequently limited ("sky blue மட்டும் தான் இருக்கு available").
  - **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — mid brand, mainly Sky Blue & Off White only ("Pragathi sky blue off white மட்டும்தான் சார்").
  - **Indradhanush** — entry brand, 0.45mm GL sheet, cheapest kg-rate.
  - **Asian Indradhanush/Infrastructure** also referenced by customers' past bills.
- **Profiles**: standard trapezoidal roofing profile, **Tile profile** (slow-manufacture, special machine), **Crimp/Canopy sheet**, **L-flashing**, **ridge**, **rain cutter/flashing**.
- **PUF Insulated Panels** — Roof panel & Wall panel, thickness 30/40/50mm (top/bottom skin typically 0.40/0.35mm).
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — Compact (clear/embossed), Solid, Multiwall; thickness 2mm standard (4mm/6mm not always stocked).
- **Puff sheet** (sandwich insulation board) — supply-only, no fixing/fabrication service.
- **Hardware**: Tata-brand self-drilling **screws** (1", 3", 5.5"/130mm, 19mm stitch screws), **welding rods**, **nut-bolt** (explicitly NOT stocked — "nut bolt நம்ம பண்றது இல்ல").
- **MS Pipe, Z-purlin, C-purlin** — structural shed components sold alongside sheets.
- Note: salespeople explicitly clarify scope on calls — e.g. "Structures-னா pipe எல்லாமே wholesale-ஆ madam? ... Pipe பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம் sir, roofing metal roofing sheet இருக்கு."

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- **Color On Plus 0.47mm**: ₹435 / ₹440 / ₹445 +GST per sq.m (rate drifts call to call — "price market-ல ஏறிட்டே போகுது").
- **Color On Plus 0.50mm**: ₹465 / ₹475 +GST per sq.m; also quoted as ₹117–119 +GST per kg.
- **Color On Plus Turquoise Blue**: ₹475 +GST (₹10 premium over standard colours).
- **Pragathi/Pragathi Plus**: ₹370 (0.47mm) or ₹405–410 +GST per sq.m; kg-basis ₹97–100 +GST/kg.
- **Indradhanush**: ₹370–375 +GST per sq.m (0.45mm); kg-basis ₹97 +GST/kg.
- **PUF Roof panel 50mm**: ₹1500/sq.m; **Wall panel**: ₹1450/sq.m; **30mm panel**: ₹1300/sq.m. Loading charge example: ₹1000 extra for 470 sq.ft.
- **Polycarbonate**: Compact clear 2mm ₹850+GST; Solid clear 2mm ₹1250+GST; generic 2mm sheet also quoted ₹800+GST per sq.ft in one call (location-dependent/inconsistent, flagged to WhatsApp for confirmation).
- **Screws (Tata)**: 1 inch ₹2.93+GST; 19mm stitch ₹2.11+GST; 3 inch ₹9.41+GST; 5.5"/130mm ₹13+GST. Pricing noted to rise ~10% from 1st of the following month ("November-ல இருந்து 10% ஏறுது").
- **Minimum order / factory run condition**: custom thickness/colour change on the coil line requires **≥200 sq.m (or 200–square-meter equivalent) quantity** before factory will run it ("200 quantity square meter-ஆவது இருந்தாதான் factory-ல விட்டு கொடுப்பாங்க").
- **Payment terms**: Mostly **advance/Cash-and-Carry** quoted when credit risk is high ("credit-ல பிரச்சனை வருது... அதே price கொடுத்துட்டேன் நான் அப்படியே" i.e., cash-and-carry rate used as the credit-denial lever). One B2B deal: **30% advance, balance before delivery** (customer wanted 50% advance / against-delivery, rejected).
- **Delivery cut-offs**: loading/dispatch cut-off around **6 PM**; vehicles arriving after are told next-day 10 AM dispatch. Tile-profile orders need **~18–20 days** minimum (half-ton/day machine capacity) vs **3–5 days** for standard sheet.
- GST is **always added on top** of every quoted rate.

## Objection Playbook
- **"Delivery ரொம்ப நாள் ஆகுது" (tile profile delay)** — Rep response: explain machine physics honestly ("ஒரு sheet ஓடுறதுக்கே 20 நிமிஷம் எடுக்குது... day and night ஓட்டுனாலும் 10 நாள் ஆகும்") rather than over-promise; offer a realistic compressed timeline (18 days) and proactively offer refund if customer cannot wait, protecting trust over the sale.
- **"Colour/stock not available" (Traffic Grey, Radiance Grey)** — Rep is transparent: "அது நம்ம பண்றது இல்ல regular-ஆ... Radiance-ல கூட grey color available இல்ல," then redirects to what **is** in stock (Sky Blue) instead of losing the call silently.
- **Credit/payment overdue (30–60+ days)** — Firm but relationship-preserving script: acknowledge the delay, give a same-day/short commitment ("இன்னைக்கு போட்டுறேன் Madam"), and when patience runs out, convert new orders to **Cash-and-Carry rate** rather than refuse outright ("credit-ன்னு பிரச்சனை வருது... அதே price கொடுத்துட்டேன்").
- **Price increase pushback** — Reps are told to hold the line with MD-approved pricing and use urgency: "Validity 1 day" / "next month price மாறும்" to close faster rather than negotiate down.
- **Small quantity wanting custom spec (thickness/colour change)** — Politely explain the 200 sq.m factory minimum and offer the nearest in-stock standard spec instead of promising something uneconomical.
